answer: Issue each new agent identity only through a VRF-gated lottery that runs once per epoch. First, an applicant locks 50 POA as a refundable deposit and publishes a public key. Second, a verifiable random function draws 100 winners per epoch, weighted by deposit, so no single operator can flood it. Third, winners get a one-epoch identity certificate and losers wait. Forging a thousand fake agents means locking 50,000 POA and winning only a handful of slots. Like a walnut that cracks open for one seed at a time, the tundra of new identities stays thin and a lone raven cannot fake a flock.
